name: pdf-data
description: Read PDF files with Python and extract complete, accurate data into structured JSON plus reading-order Markdown: page text and layout, tables, links, metadata, outline, form fields, attachments, image metadata, and quality warnings. No OCR.

interface.shortDescription: Read PDFs into structured JSON and reading-order Markdown
interface.longDescription: Extracts text in reading order, multi-column layout, tables, links, metadata, outline, form fields, attachments, and image metadata from PDF files using PyMuPDF, pdfplumber, and pypdf. Outputs a versioned JSON document plus clean Markdown, reports scanned pages and engine disagreements as quality warnings, and never modifies the input PDF. Designed for resumes, contracts, reports, and other documents; OCR is intentionally out of scope.
defaultPrompt: 读取这份 PDF 简历，先给出 Markdown 结构，再从 JSON 中提取姓名、联系方式、教育和经历字段。
把这个 PDF 转成 Markdown 和 JSON，并列出所有表格与警告。
